video.title: AI欧腐《孤岛游戏：总裁的执念/Island Game: My CEO's Obsession》
video.desc:
Noah is a male Omega, and nobody knows. To clear his father’s debt he sells one night on a private island in a wig and a mask, and wakes the wrong Alpha — Hawk Lawrence, his new boss. A swapped wristband sends Hawk after an impostor while Noah hides a pregnancy and his parents put a price on him. He has been sold his whole life. One man refuses to buy.

Noah 是个男性 Omega，无人知晓。为了替父亲还债，他戴上假发和面具，在一座私人岛屿上卖掉了自己的一夜——却睡错了 Alpha：Hawk Lawrence，他的新上司。一只被调换的手环让 Hawk 追错了人，而 Noah 一边隐瞒怀孕，一边被亲生父母明码标价。
他这一生，一直在被人贩卖。只有一个男人，拒绝买下他。
